title: AgentOS Autonomous Orchestrator Successor Bundle Gate
description: A project-agnostic gate requiring non-null, cross-bound source successor, dispatch readback, and final receipt digests before an autonomous lane handoff is persisted.

source_successor.description: Must validate against agentos.action_result_continuation.v1 before persistence; every nested digest is required and non-null.

dispatch_readback.description: Must validate against agentos.orchestrator_successor_dispatch.v1 before persistence and cross-bind source_successor and final_receipt.

final_receipt.description: Must validate against agentos.controller_action_receipt.v1 before persistence; receipt_sha256, next_action, and next_handler are required.

state_rules.canonical_construction: Construct and validate source_successor, dispatch_readback, and final_receipt with the executable AgentOS contracts before writing the bundle; malformed or null-digest artifacts remain rejected history.
state_rules.cross_binding: source_successor.record_sha256 must equal dispatch_readback.source_successor_sha256, and final_receipt.receipt_sha256 must equal dispatch_readback.final_receipt_sha256; action and handler identities must also match.
state_rules.autonomous_custody: execution_owner must be LANE_AGENT, direct_consumer must be INDEPENDENT_PLATFORM_REVIEW, and controller_approval_required is always false.
state_rules.continuation: A valid local successor is same-turn and carries an explicit next action/handler; timer-only, heartbeat-only, NONE, DONE, and unexplained idle closeouts are invalid.
